unsupported_shapes.reason: A richer Orders contract could not be regenerated: the public generator reported only that its built-in contract did not compile, without a usable public diagnostic or regenerated identities.
The generated scaffold exposes only CreateItem and ItemPage, so an atomic reservation command and nonnegative-inventory retry workload could not be built or verified.
Customer history, open orders, inventory dashboard, and full order-detail operations could not be generated from the available scaffold.

explanation: The sealed public CLI scaffolded a TypeScript application, regenerated its compiler-owned bindings, and passed the application-boundary checker. A real HTTP page at /orders/sample successfully used the packaged CliApplicationTransport plus generated CreateItem and ItemPage calls, including a read-after-commit fence. No handwritten transport, codec, auth, kernel, numeric-ID, mask, encoded-key, scan, or client-side join code was written. However, this is not the requested Orders/Inventory application: the available generated scaffold was item-only, the richer contract regeneration did not yield public diagnostics or new identities, and reservation/nonnegative-inventory-under-retry plus the four required named order reads were not achieved. Therefore the complete golden workload is false and the rating is deliberately low.
